name: Thomas Lab
affiliation: University of Georgia · College of Pharmacy
tagline: Precision therapeutics through data, genomics, and AI.

hero.eyebrow: Computational precision medicine · Clinical AI · Real-world evidence
hero.summary: We develop rigorous computational methods that connect pharmacogenomics, electronic health records, and real-world evidence to improve medication safety and individualize treatment.

research_areas.title: Pharmacogenomics
research_areas.description: Understanding how genetic variation shapes medication response and translating that evidence into better treatment decisions.

research_areas.title: Clinical NLP
research_areas.description: Extracting actionable phenotypes and adverse events from unstructured clinical narratives with reproducible NLP methods.

research_areas.title: Healthcare AI
research_areas.description: Building transparent machine-learning systems for clinical risk stratification, outcome prediction, and decision support.

research_areas.title: Real-World Evidence
research_areas.description: Integrating EHR, claims, structured, and unstructured data to evaluate treatment effectiveness and safety in practice.

research_areas.title: Cardiovascular Precision Medicine
research_areas.description: Personalizing antiplatelet therapy and cardiovascular pharmacotherapy using clinical, genetic, and real-world signals.

research_areas.title: Medication Safety
research_areas.description: Detecting adverse drug outcomes and balancing efficacy against safety at the individual-patient level.

seo.title: Thomas Lab — Precision Therapeutics, Pharmacogenomics & Clinical AI
seo.description: Thomas Lab at the University of Georgia College of Pharmacy develops research in pharmacogenomics, precision medicine, clinical NLP, healthcare AI, real-world evidence, and medication safety.
